title: Juicy Dutch Beef Roast
description: A savory Dutch dish featuring a tender roast beef with a crunchy pecan crust. Low in sodium and rich in flavor.
instructions: Season the beef roast with salt-free seasoning blend, rosemary, and garlic powder.
In a small bowl, mix together brown mustard, honey, and apple cider vinegar.
Rub the mustard mixture all over the beef roast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef roast on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and roast the beef for 2 hours, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
While the beef is roasting, mix together the chopped pecans and a pinch of salt-free seasoning blend.
After the beef has roasted for 2 hours, remove it from the oven and brush the pecan mixture all over the top.
Return the Dutch oven to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the pecans are golden brown.
Remove the beef from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
